sections.title: 一、图文配对
sections.instruction: 给下列图片选择相应的内容。

questions.prompt: [*VISUAL: 一朵呼呼吹风且卷起落叶的云朵（表示多云且刮风的天气）*]
questions.explanation: 图片展示了一朵吹风并卷起落叶的云朵，代表多云且刮风的天气，对应选项 E. cloudy and windy。

questions.prompt: [*VISUAL: 一位站在黑板前讲课的教师（表示老师）*]
questions.explanation: 图片展示了一位在黑板前讲课的教师，对应选项 B. teacher。

questions.prompt: [*VISUAL: 一个蛋筒冰淇淋（表示冰淇淋）*]
questions.explanation: 图片展示了一个蛋筒冰淇淋，对应选项 A. ice cream。

questions.prompt: [*VISUAL: 电视播报员正在播报天气预报的场景（表示天气预报）*]
questions.explanation: 图片展示了电视播报天气预报的场景，对应选项 D. weather report。

questions.prompt: [*VISUAL: 正在雪地里堆雪人的场景/孩子（表示堆雪人）*]
questions.explanation: 图片展示了在雪地里堆雪人的场景，对应选项 C. make a snowman。

sections.title: 二、单项选择
sections.instruction: 选择可以填入句子空白处的最佳答案。

questions.prompt: ______ is the weather like today?
questions.explanation: 询问天气的固定句型为 “What is the weather like?” 或 “How is the weather?”。由于后文已有 is，故此处填 What，选 B。

questions.prompt: Hot, cold, cool or warm. We can enjoy ______ weather.
questions.translation: 炎热、寒冷、凉爽或温暖。我们可以享受任何天气。
questions.explanation: any 表示“任何的”，修饰名词 weather，意为享受任何天气，故选 C。

questions.prompt: It's ______. Please take your umbrella.
questions.translation: 下雨了。请带上你的雨伞。
questions.explanation: It's 后接形容词表示天气情况。rainy 是形容词“下雨的”，wind 和 rain 是名词或动词，故选 B。

questions.prompt: ______ the TV, please. We want to watch TV.
questions.translation: 请打开电视。我们想看电视。
questions.explanation: 打开电器（如电视）用动词短语 turn on。Open 不能用来打开电视；turn off 表示关闭。故选 B。

questions.prompt: It never ______ in Sanya.
questions.explanation: 句子是一般现在时，主语 It 是第三人称单数，谓语动词用三单形式 snows，故选 B。

sections.title: 三、根据提示选择天气
sections.instruction: 同学们正在收拾行李箱。根据提示，选择当地对应的天气描述。

questions.prompt: It's ______ in Sydney. [*VISUAL: 打开的行李箱，气泡提示里装着短袖T恤和防晒遮阳帽*]
questions.explanation: 行李箱里装有短袖T恤和遮阳帽，对应晴朗炎热的天气 B. sunny and hot。

questions.prompt: It's ______ in Beijing. [*VISUAL: 打开的行李箱，气泡提示里装着风筝和长袖外衬衫*]
questions.explanation: 行李箱里装有风筝和长袖衬衫，对应有风且温暖的天气 A. windy and warm。

questions.prompt: It's ______ in Paris. [*VISUAL: 打开的行李箱，气泡提示里装着雨伞和雨靴*]
questions.explanation: 行李箱里装有雨伞和雨靴，对应下雨凉爽的天气 D. rainy and cool。

questions.prompt: It's ______ in Moscow. [*VISUAL: 打开的行李箱，气泡提示里装着厚羽绒服/棉服和雪地靴*]
questions.explanation: 行李箱里装有厚棉服和雪地靴，对应下雪寒冷的天气 C. snowy and cold。

questions.prompt: She is my t______. She teaches English.
questions.translation: 她是我的老师。她教英语。
questions.explanation: 根据后半句“She teaches English”（她教英语）和首字母 t 提示，此处填 teacher。

questions.prompt: Children have fun in the s______. [*VISUAL: 下雪的雪地里立着一个雪人*]
questions.translation: 孩子们在雪地里玩得很开心。
questions.explanation: 根据图片雪地/雪人和首字母 s 提示，此处填 snow。

questions.prompt: It's cold outside. You need to take your c______. [*VISUAL: 一件厚大衣/外套*]
questions.translation: 外面冷。你需要带上你的外套。
questions.explanation: 根据图片厚外套和首字母 c 提示，此处填 coat。

questions.prompt: Today is w______. We can fly kites in the park.
questions.translation: 今天刮风。我们可以去公园放风筝。
questions.explanation: 根据后半句“fly kites”（放风筝）和首字母 w 提示，形容天气刮风用 windy。

questions.prompt: I like eating i______ c______. It tastes good.
questions.translation: 我喜欢吃冰淇淋。它尝起来很棒。
questions.explanation: 根据首字母 i 和 c 提示，此处填冰淇淋短语 ice cream。

sections.title: 五、补全对话
sections.instruction: 选择合适的选项补全对话。
sections.passage:
**Tina:** John, this is Tina.
**John:** Hi, Tina. 1. [1] Is it sunny today?
**Tina:** 2. [2] It's rainy and windy. 3. [3]
**John:** It's sunny and warm. 4. [4]
**Tina:** That's great! 5. [5]
**John:** Thank you!
wordbank: What's the weather like in London?
I can go out to play with friends.

questions.answer: What's the weather like in London?
questions.explanation: Tina 打电话给 John 询问天气，符合单元主题，对应询问伦敦天气的句子 What's the weather like in London?
对上一句问句 “Is it sunny today?” 作出回答，后文提到 “It's rainy and windy”，因此 security 否为 No, it isn't。
Tina 描述完自己城市的天气后反问 John 所在的地方，接下句 John 回答“It's sunny and warm”，故选 What about your city?

questions.answer: I can go out to play with friends.
questions.explanation: John 描述自己城市天气晴朗温暖后，补充说明可以做的事情，故选 I can go out to play with friends.
对话结束时的祝愿语，后接 John 的“Thank you!”，故选 Have a nice day!

sections.title: 六、阅读判断
sections.instruction: 根据材料内容，判断下列句子正(T)误(F)。
sections.passage:
Good morning! Here is the weather report today.
Shenzhen: It's very hot. It's 35°C. You can go swimming.
Chengdu: It's cloudy and warm. You can go out to play.
Lanzhou: It's rainy and cool. You must take your umbrella.
Qingdao: It's sunny and warm. It's 25°C. It feels so nice. You can go shopping.
Harbin: It's windy and cold. Please put on your coat.

questions.prompt: This is the world weather report.
questions.explanation: 表格中所列城市均为中国城市（深圳、成都、兰州、青岛、哈尔滨），属于国内天气预报而非世界天气预报，故表述错误。

questions.prompt: It's very hot in Shenzhen.
questions.explanation: 根据表格 “Shenzhen: It's very hot. It's 35°C.” 可知表述正确。

questions.prompt: It's warm in Chengdu. You can go outside.
questions.translation: 成都天气温暖。你可以出去玩。
questions.explanation: 根据表格 “Chengdu: It's cloudy and warm. You can go out to play.” 可知表述正确。

questions.prompt: It snows in Lanzhou.
questions.explanation: 根据表格 “Lanzhou: It's rainy and cool.”（兰州下雨且凉爽）可知兰州是在下雨，而不是下雪，故表述错误。

questions.prompt: It's windy and cold in Harbin. You can put on your coat.
questions.translation: 哈尔滨刮风且寒冷。你可以穿上外套。
questions.explanation: 根据表格 “Harbin: It's windy and cold. Please put on your coat.” 可知表述正确。

sections.title: 七、看图完成句子
sections.instruction: 根据下列图片提示，仿照材料内容，选择合适的选项完成句子。
sections.passage: Weather reports & daily activities in Xiamen and Lhasa

questions.prompt:
1. Xiamen
[*VISUAL: 标注 Xiamen 的图画，左侧为电视屏幕上显示着太阳图样（晴天/热），右侧配有一个指示高温的温度计*]
It's ______ in Xiamen. I can watch TV at home.
questions.translation: 厦门天气很热。我可以在家看电视。
questions.explanation: 结合表格语篇风格以及图片上高温温度计与太阳标志，此处选择 A. hot。

questions.prompt:
2. Lhasa
[*VISUAL: 标注 Lhasa 的图画，左侧为雪地里立着雪人的下雪场景，右侧配有一个指示低温的温度计*]
It's ______.
questions.explanation: 图片显示拉萨有雪人和低温温度计，选择 A. cold and snowy。

questions.prompt: Lhasa 后半句活动填空: I ______.
questions.explanation: 结合雪人图片和下雪天活动，选择 A. can make a snowman。
